tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// tshad ma'i sgom rim phul du byung ba'i snying po zhes bya ba/ bla ma dang lhag pa'i lha la phyag 'tshal lo// mkhyen brtse'i cha shas yongs rdzogs shing*// phrin las 'od stong rgyas pa yis// 'gro ba'i mi shes mun sel ba// thub dbang de la phyag 'tshal lo// shes rab mchog tu yangs pa'i mkha'// legs sbyangs rnam dpyod chu 'dzin las// rig pa'i glog 'od rab 'khyug pa// phyogs kyi glang po la phyag 'tshal// rigs pas phas kyi rgol ba bzlog /lung don lta ba'i don rtogs pas// chos min smra ba spong mdzad pa'i// chos kyi grags pa la phyag 'tshal// yun du brtags kyang rtogs dka'i don// tshad ma'i man ngag gnad bsdus pa'i// rigs lam ngo mtshar phul byung ba// skyon bral ngag gis bshad par bya// 'dir skal ba dang ldan pas sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par byed pa'i thabs tshang la ma nor ba 'di lta ste/ skyabs 'gro dang sems bskyed kyis lam gyi gzhi bzung*/ lam gyi dngos gzhi thabs shes gnyis bsgom pa'i tshul/ de las thob pa'i 'bras bu bstan pa'o// dang po la/ tshad mar gyur pa 'gro la phan bzhed pa// ston pa bde gshegs skyob la phyag 'tshal te// zhes gsungs pas/ skyabs su 'gro ba'i yul dang*/ skyabs 'gro dngos bstan la/ 'gro la phan bzhed pa zhes pas sems bskyed bstan no// ston pa dang*/ bde gshegs dang skyob pa gsum gyis lam gyi 'bras bu bstan pa yin no// slob dpon phyogs glang gis lam gyi dngos gzhi rgyas pa ni/ brgyad stong don bsdus su bstan la/ ji snyed pa'i cha ni mngon pa mdzod kyi 'grel pa gnad kyi sgron mer bstan no// dpal ldan chos kyi grags pa'i bzhed tshul ni/ rtog pa'i drwa ba rnam bsal zhing*// zhes sogs sho lo ka gcig gis skyabs 'gro bstan/ sgrub byed thugs rje goms las de// zhes pas sems bskyed bstan no// gnyis pa lam gyi dngos gzhi'i bsgom tshul la'ang*/

shes rab sgom tshul dang*/ thabs sgom tshul gnyis so// dang po la bden bzhi'i rnam pa mi rtag la sogs bcu drug gsungs so// de'ang stong nyid bsgom pa'i tshul dang*/ de'i yan lag gi cha gnyis su gsungs so// dang po la/ stong nyid lta bas grol gyur gyi// sgom pa lhag ma de don yin// zhes gsungs so// ci'i phyir stong pa nyid kho nas grol bar 'gyur gyi gzhan gyis min zhe na/ nyes pa thams cad kyi rtsa ba bdag 'dzin yin la/ bdag 'dzin gyi gnyen por/ bdag med rtogs pa'i shes rab dgos pa'i phyir ro// ji skad du yang*/ nyes pa rnam pa thams cad dag /'jigs tshogs lta las skyes pa yin// zhes so// 'o na las sgrib dag pa'i thabs su gzungs sgrub dang*/ smyung gnas dang*/ sbyin sreg dka' thub la sogs byas pas/ sgrib pa dang sdig pa rtsa ba nas 'dag gam snyam na/ las zad dub pa don med yin// zhes so// byams sogs tshad med bzhi bsgoms pas nyon mongs pa spong ngo snyam na/ byams sogs rmongs dang 'gal med phyir// shin tu nyes pa tshar gcod min// zhes gsungs so// 'o na bdag med rtogs pa'i shes rab kyis kyang spong mi nus snyam na/ bdag med bdag dang 'gal bas na// bdag med rtogs pas de sun 'byin// zhes gsungs so// 'o na bdag med rtogs pa'i lta ba ji ltar bsgom zhe na/ 'di yul sun dbyung med par ni// de spong bar ni spong mi nus// zhes pas/ bdag tu 'dzin pa'i yul phung po lnga gtan la phab nas/ yul can bdag 'dzin bzlog go /lan gcig spangs kyang slar ldog snyam na/ 'bad du zin kyang mi ldog ste// blo ni de phyogs 'dzin phyir ro// zhes gsungs so// gang zag gi bdag med bsgom pa kho nar ma zad kyi chos kyi bdag med kyang bsgom dgos par bstan pa ni/ ji lta ji ltar don bsam pa// de lta de ltar rnam bral zhes// mkhas pa rnams kyis gang gsungs pa// de ni dngos stobs 'ongs pa yin// zhes gsungs so// don bsam par bya ba'i rigs pa gang zhe na/

gang gis dngos po rnam dpyad na// de nyid dus na de dngos med// gang gi rang bzhin de dag la// gcig dang du ma'i rang bzhin med// ces gsungs pas bstan no// de la rtsod spong ni/ gzung 'dzin tha dad du snang ba dang 'gal lo snyam na/ blo bdag rnam par dbyer med kyang*// mthong ba phyin ci log rnams kyis// gzung dang 'dzin pa rig pa dag /tha dad gzhan ni rtogs par 'gyur// dper na dbang po sngags sogs kyis// bslad pa rnams la 'jim dum sogs// de yi gzugs dang bral ba yang*// rnam pa gzhan du snang ba bzhin// de dag ma bslad mig can gyis// de ltar mthong ba med phyir ro// zhes so// des na gzung 'dzin gnyis med kyi shes pa rang rig rang gsal ni lta ba mthar thug go /ji skad du/ gzung dang 'dzin pa med pa'i phyir// de ni de ltar rang nyid gsal// zhes so// 'o na shes rab rkyang pas chog gam snyam na/ gnyis pa thabs kyang dgos par bstan pa ni/ rnam pa du mar thabs mang po// yun ring dus su goms pa las// de la skyon dang yon tan dag /rab tu gsal ba nyid du gyur// zhes gsungs so// bden bzhi'i rnam pa lhag ma rnams bstan pa don med do snyam na/ kun 'byung gi bden pa'i rnam pa bzhi bstan pas ni/ kun 'byung gi nyes dmigs rtogs nas myur du spong ba la 'jug pa'i don no// 'gog pa'i rnam pa bzhi bstan pas ni/ thar pa'i phan yon mthong nas de mngon du byed pa la 'jug go /lam gyi rnam pa bzhi bstan pas ni nyon mongs spong ba la lam rgyud la brten dgos zhes pa'i don no// gsum pa de las thob pa'i 'bras bu ni/ de ldan bcom ldan tshad ma nyid// ces gsungs shing*/ rnam nges las kyang*/ 'khrul pas dben zhing dri ma dang bral ba las bzlog pa med par don dam pa'i 'gog pa mngon du byed do// zhes gsungs pas/ yang dag pa'i rigs pa'i don gyi man ngag 'di la rtse gcig tu 'bad par bya'o// 'phags pa'i yul dang gangs ri'i khrod rnams su// tshad ma'i bshad pa byed pa mang na yang*// snying po'i don kun shes pa ma mthong bas// rjes 'jug skye bo rjes su gzung bya'i phyir// tshad ma'i sgom rim phul byung snying po bshad// de yi dge bas mtha' yas 'gro ba kun// tshad ma'i mkhyen ldan sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das// thams cad mkhyen pa'i go 'phang thob gyur cig
/ces tshad ma'i sgom rim phul du byung ba'i snying po zhes bya ba 'di slar yang rong ston shes bya kun rig gis dpal nā len+d+ra'i dgon par sbyar ba dge legs 'phel bar gyur cig/ //

tshad ma'i sgom rim 'di gnyis don gcig tu 'dug kyang mchan dang rgyas bsdus dbu 'jug gi rtsom sogs mi 'dra ba snga phyir mdzad par mngon pas gnyis ka bkod cing ma dpe gzhan bsdur sa ma rnyed pas yig nor yin nges las bcos med sor bzhag zhus// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten nye 'dabs nas rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa las/ slob bu tha shal pa gu rus spel ba'o//
